protocol.initial_condition: one M0 legal retained prefix per UID at first release; independent caches thereafter; no per-edge Parent reinitialization
protocol.policy: formula reject if b>tau; formula accept if a=0 and b<=tau; otherwise compare remaining full check (prepare view+16 C reads+225D detector) with Current KV rebuild+new summary; rebuild if check>=rebuild, else run frozen detector and rebuild on rejection
protocol.numerical_policy: same FP64 bounds and 1e-10 decision guard as conditional225_01; uncertainty escalates to original solve, unless its remaining cost is already >= rebuild

protocol.service: real frozen feedback requests; query before writes at same timestamp; native append chunks <=128 cut at every request group; independent four-path replay
protocol.rebuild_semantics: Current full retained prefix replaces real KV and summary; invalidate view, detector and decision; no correction until next model change; preserve release age separately from rebuild anchor
protocol.M2: native transition only, no detector or rebuild, invalidate current-model anchor and old views
protocol.quality: per-edge AUC and equal-four-edge mean; paired UID bootstrap1000; later real requests and writes-since-release bands; no decision-panel quality success criterion

protocol.alternatives_if_needed: At most two evidence-driven execution/policy alternatives, frozen before new results; no change to detector. Preserve the initial failure and do not tune against confirmation.
